transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the morning airfield coordination huddle. We've got three routine cargo aircraft — Airlift-1, Airlift-2, and Airlift-3 — arriving tomorrow morning, and I need to get the ramp board published after we sort out any constraints. We've got three ramp windows available: 0900-1000, 1100-1230, and 1300-1500. Standard procedure is to assign in manifest order unless someone has an operational constraint I need to know about. Aviation liaison, S-4 logistics — what are you seeing on your end? Any constraints I need to factor in?

transcript.text: Sir, I have a confirmed constraint on my end. Airlift-3 carries eight pallets requiring exactly 120 minutes of forklift-supported unloading, and the only qualified heavy forklift is booked for another task from 1100 to 1200. I confirmed the equipment booking with the motor pool this morning, but the restriction hasn't been posted to the airfield schedule yet. This means Airlift-3 cannot use the 1100-1230 window, since the forklift won't be available until 1200 and the window only provides 30 minutes after that — not enough for the 120-minute unload. Airlift-3 would need the 1300-1500 window to get the full two hours of forklift support.
